title: Arkanoid

tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04 cloud container with four cores and no display

exclude: runtime: working copy of characters 64-127 (the background tiles), rewritten each round from $EA00, $EC00 or $EE00 by $F552 and $9C59
extra: an unused variant of characters 128-255, outside the character window; no instruction reads it
include: sprite shapes $40-$7F under the I/O area, read by the video chip in bank 3

regions: character set: font, background tiles (runtime), bricks, panel and walls
the sound driver: tune start, reset, sound effects, three sequencers, effect ticks, filter
tune table (9 records of 7 bytes), sequences, instruments, envelopes, pitch and filter programs, arpeggio tables
unused: an older build of the sound driver, assembled $1000 higher
the play screen's panel template, screen codes
the Doh screen, 26 x 24 screen codes
unreferenced multicolour character shapes, a near-copy of $EA00
